response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced full-stack engineer (~15+ years) with genuine strengths in testing culture, developer tooling, and some high-throughput systems work (low-latency services handling millions of requests/second at Dunnhumby). However, the role is a Principal-level position centered on experimentation platforms, growth measurement, telemetry infrastructure, and cross-org technical leadership — none of which appear in the resume. There is no evidence of building A/B testing or feature-flagging systems, statistical/experimental analysis, or leading multi-team initiatives at Principal/IC6 scope. Recent roles are senior IC product engineering, a significant level and domain gap for this position.
strengths: 15+ years of broad engineering experience across web, backend, mobile, and embedded, exceeding the 8-year requirement
Hands-on high-scale distributed systems experience (low-latency microservices handling millions of HTTP requests/second)
Strong quality/testing culture: TDD, CI/CD, open-source test tooling, workshops, and mentoring through talks and courses
concerns: No demonstrated experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or growth-measurement platform experience — the core of the role
No evidence of Principal-level scope: leading multi-workstream initiatives, cross-team architecture, or platforms adopted by multiple teams at a large org
Limited data/statistics depth shown; no telemetry, metrics infrastructure, or experimental-analysis track record

key_factors.factor: Strong engineering fundamentals and scale experience
